scope: Current progressive-online experiments from 2026-10-16 through 2026-10-18, with root-level results, comparison tables, run states, available performance/score summaries, logs, and current implementation source snapshot. Failed and incomplete runs retain their original status.
limitations: Latest global_split uses fixed 512-token greedy generation; no task-quality claim.
APC is off; raw block relocation is unsupported; preemption invalidates points.
No DRAM counters. Component times are not additive online percentages.
Model weights, datasets, raw per-request databases, tensor captures, runtime dependency copies and compiled caches are excluded.
